svg.text: UniFi zone-based firewall · 7 networks · servers isolated on VLAN 50 · dashed = planned
UniFi Dream Router 7 · gateway + zone firewall
WAN on port 4 (2.5GbE) · DHCP for every VLAN · 192.168.1.1
UPnP: Default + Gaming only, Secure Mode on
USW-Lite-8-PoE · end-device ports: Block All tagged VLANs
Least privilege: only the Proxmox port carries tagged VLANs
192.168.1.0/24 · admin laptop, family phones and laptops, Beelink, Deco mesh
Only network allowed to start connections into other VLANs · reaches the UDR7 admin UI
IoT WiFi: 2.4 GHz only, MLO off
Block Kids · Gaming · IoT · Camera → Gateway TCP 22 / 80 / 443
Backup on Pi (.30) · allow TCP/UDP 53 from every VLAN to .22 + .30 only · switch DHCP DNS one VLAN at a time
Subnet router, no open ports · then block the discontinued cameras from the internet
Smart devices → IoT SSID · kids' devices → Kids SSID
When the RMA drive arrives · Proxmox backups to the NAS
Home Assistant (IoT), Vaultwarden, Portainer, CrowdSec, Wazuh SIEM
Deco mesh → Gaming, then drop Default from UPnP
Reverse proxy + Let's Encrypt DNS challenge · Authelia 2FA
Return traffic is allowed automatically, so an isolated device can answer a connection but never start one. Every admin login uses 2FA.
No public IPs, SSID names, MAC addresses or keys appear in this diagram.
